unmapped is added to an mmu_gather_batch structure for asynchronous
freeing. If we run out of space in the batch structure before the range

column2: then we break out of the loop

we forget to update addr when we break out of the loop

column1: which causes us to truncate the range being invalidated as the end
address is exclusive. When we re-enter the loop at the same address
